gates.name: 30-minute functional
prerequisites: Separately approved fictional research realm and versioned duration/continuation policy
Owned persistent storage, telemetry/export and recovery contract
pass_criteria: One continuing population/RNG/best and one owner
No hard-invalid successful candidate, lost required observations or mixed contexts
Authorized pause/resume/browser reconnect and process restart where specified
Bounded memory/disk and exact exported record consistency
stop_conditions: Identity/bundle/config/lineage mismatch
Unauthorized action or unexpected path/database access
NaN or best-ever regression
Missing required metrics or corrupt checkpoint
Resource/disk floor exceeded or unsupported power/resume state
measurements: Process working set and private commit separately
